rules.logic: ABIOC(Lateral Tool Transfer to Never-Before-Seen Tunneler over HTTPS) AND ABIOC(Anomalous Remote-Service Fan-Out from Newly-Written Tool) fire on the same agent_hostname, and the NDR XQL(Long-Lived TCP-443 Tunnel Session Observable in network_story) shares that host src_ip within a 15-minute window. The three signals stitch into one lateral-movement and privilege-escalation incident_id whose causality chain spans EDR process lineage (HTTPS archive fetch -> never-before-seen chisel.exe execution -> psexec.exe peer fan-out) and NDR session telemetry (the long-lived TCP/443 tunnel) — the Muddled Libra lateral-tool-transfer playbook as a single incident rather than three unlinked alerts.
rules.name: Muddled Libra Lateral Tool Transfer + Tunnel + PsExec Fan-Out — Cross-Plane Causality Stitch
